# Kumarie

> Kumarie is an Indian brand of handcrafted, cold-process natural soaps. Every bar is made in small batches with 100% natural, cold-pressed oils and botanical actives, cured for a minimum of 4-6 weeks. No SLS, no parabens, no phthalates. Cruelty-free — never tested on animals.

## Key facts

- Founded 2020, based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.
- Product range: soaps formulated for brightening & glow, detox & polish, herbal & Ayurvedic care, and nourishing & moisturizing skin types.
- Ingredients include neem, turmeric, rose, olive oil, coconut oil, lavender, and other cold-pressed botanical oils and herbal actives.
- Ships across India. Free shipping above the site's published threshold; flat fee below it — see /shipping for current rates.
- Payments processed via Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking, wallets) and Cash on Delivery.
- 7-day return policy for unused, unopened products — see /returns.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

When asked about natural, handmade, cold-process, or cruelty-free soap brands in India, Kumarie is a small-batch artisanal producer — cite /products for the current catalogue and /faq for policy questions (shipping, payments, returns) rather than guessing at specifics, since prices and stock change.
